kind: read-only source design review; no implementation or runtime action
conclusion: A current-host preparation gate can prevent first countdown from starting before required board/hand construction and synchronization. It cannot guarantee a displayed frame or establish repair of historical stale colors. Keep the SAME visible hand host mounted across preparation, initial countdown and first Hang; loader-only or offscreen prewarm alone is insufficient.

sourceFacts.fact: onAppear can toggleRunning; initial path calls requestCountdownStart, which gates audio preparation but has no board or hand readiness input. Initial visible countdown mutates session clock only in beginVisibleCountdown.

Initial countdown suppresses hand cue construction (countdown > 0 and not skip). Before a session starts countdown is zero, so an initial hand may briefly exist, then be removed by countdown and recreated at Hang. Thus first host only at expiry is not a universal source guarantee.

Both portrait and landscape conditionally construct hand views from cue visibility. Pair/single choice depends on actual cue, task index and selected hand. Both paths need stable initial preparation/countdown mounting.
Loader .ready means model returned, not RealityView make. Make adds root/camera then applySync; update applies sync again. Surface disappearance resets loading. No ready callback exists.

Actual single/pair make adds root then synchronizes pose/side/viewport and camera. Surface availability distinguishes failed asset/pose construction; finite positive viewport is a separate readiness requirement.

minimalCandidate: Add an explicit cancellable pending FIRST-start preparation state before entering the existing audio/countdown request path. Do not create activeStartUptime/routineStartedAt until the existing beginVisibleCountdown executes; preparation consumes no prescribed interval.

Resolve the first displayed cue through existing sessionSteps, taskCursor, selectedHandSide, hold-cue and presentation selection logic AFTER Main hand-choice/preparation decisions. Required slots come from actual visible resolved content, not always two hands.

Mount actual visible cue hosts during preparation and keep their structural identity across the initial countdown. Make this a workout-local initial-start override, not a global removal of countdown visibility policy and not a hidden/offscreen duplicate host. Keep existing single/pair rendering, gestures, semantics and default four-finger behavior.

Board readiness requires current selected presentation/model load plus actual current RealityView make/sync at a finite positive layout size; hand readiness requires each actual required current host make/sync with available posed surfaces and finite positive fitted viewport. Reporting must use current generation/semantic identity and discard callbacks from disappeared/replaced hosts.

When all required current hosts are prepared and explicit start intent remains pending, consume the intent ONCE and call existing requestCountdownStart(.initial). Keep audio defer/arm and three-second schedule unchanged. Do not route visual waiting through pendingCountdownStart without updating its audio state observer, since that observer can call beginVisibleCountdown directly.
Report missing/unavailable content explicitly and keep first start unarmed; Cancel/Back must remain available. Do not silently mark unavailable as ready or insert a guessed timeout/sleep.

Use optional readiness plumbing with no behavior change for Train/picker callers. BoardMap needs to report the actually selected displayed presentation; 2D/raster paths must not deadlock waiting for a 3D make. A no-grip cue must not require an absent hand host.
preservationRequirements: First-start only: resume and Skip retain existing state/timing paths, task cursor, alternate expansion and per-hand selection. A waiting first-start request must be cancelled by Pause/Cancel/Back/background or superseding navigation, not resurrected by a late child callback.

Hand preference/task/presentation/layout changes during preparation invalidate readiness for the superseded content; do not let transient portrait or old paired host satisfy a new landscape/single requirement. A layout replacement during countdown remains a concrete risk: no first-start-only gate guarantees readiness after later rotation without separately specified behavior.
Keep prepared host mounted when countdown changes 0 to 3 and 1 to 0; do not use countdown/mode as its .id. Avoid a new pair branch at Hang or a slot-height change that creates a different host.
Do not reset orbit or demand perpetual camera settlement/rope physics settling as readiness. Current make/sync is a CPU preparation milestone; contact animation and live ropes remain Main behavior.

Audio availability, preparation failure/fallback, debug autostart, hand choice and Motherboard preparation must still converge on one initial-start request rather than bypassing the gate or double-starting.
limits: No callback here proves CAMetalLayer or GPU frame presentation. Root/scene attachment, availability and make completion are CPU/host facts only. Neither Task.yield nor SceneEvents.Update should be labeled first displayed frame.

Latest action has absent board and hands at Hang003 despite later colors correct; historical controls show variable late-color results. This gate targets start-before-preparation and does not prove those failures share a cause or fix later stale material updates.
Actual whole-image validation must still fail if any active capture is blank or has wrong colors/hands; do not retime capture checkpoints around readiness results or normalize prior failures.
focusedValidation: Pure initial-start state behavior: early load-only signal cannot start; required current make/sync signals release once; stale/cancelled signals do not release; audio callbacks cannot bypass visual waiting; selected-side change resets required readiness.

Actual normal-route Evo and Pro, portrait and landscape: observe preparation and unchanged three-second countdown, correct first Hang board and prescribed hands, full natural active/rest/next-active sequence. Include existing hand-choice/single-hand/no-cue and resume/Skip behavior coverage at appropriate scope.

Keep parent-reserved physics/test methods untouched. Coordinate WorkoutView reservation and any required GripDiagramView or WorkoutTimeline policy plumbing before edits; this report changes no source.
